background_story: Sylas was an adventurous aardvark, also known as an orycteropus, who lived in the sun-kissed savannas of Africa. By night, he would venture out to hunt for termites and ants, using his powerful claws and long, sticky tongue to gather his favorite snacks. Despite his nocturnal nature, Sylas was a social creature and loved to interact with his fellow aardvarks. He was particularly close to his sister, Akira, and the two would often go on exploratory missions together, uncovering hidden termite mounds and secret waterholes. Sylas's curious spirit and adaptability made him a beloved member of his aardvark community, and his name became synonymous with bravery and cunning in the animal kingdom.
